key.name: accent-color
key.summary: Accent colour of the Control Center
key.description: The colour of the active tiles, sliders and buttons of the Control Center. "auto" follows the theme set in System Settings, Themes (Mint-Y-Blue gives blue); CaramOS's own theme, and themes without a colour, give the CaramOS orange. "custom" uses custom-accent.

key.name: custom-accent
key.summary: Colour picked with the colour chooser
key.description: The accent colour as #rrggbb, used when accent-color is "custom". The Control Center's "Other colour…" opens a colour chooser that sets it.
